verdict.rationale: Draft A provides deeper causal analysis of refranchising, margin drivers, and cash conversion, with better coverage of balance sheet and red flags. Draft B has a grounding issue: it claims total debt is incomplete but cites only short-term borrowings, not the full debt line. A's claims are better supported.

Draft A provides deeper, better-supported analysis: it explains the FY2025 margin jump via other operating charges, quantifies segment contributions, flags data breaks, and gives concrete watch items. Draft B has unsupported claims (e.g., debt-funded buybacks) and weaker grounding. A wins on grounding and depth.
